context: Video games released the same week; players browsing store pages decide what to buy and play.

variants.label: Moonlight Peaks
variants.seed_text: Moonlight Peaks. Gothic life sim / farming sim. Developer: Little Chicken Game Company (Netherlands). Publisher: Marvelous Europe. Platforms: PC (Steam), Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, Google Play Games. Release: July 7, 2026. Franchise status: new IP. Not early access; a free Steam demo covering seven in-game days was available before launch. Price: standard edition listed at 35 USD on Steam; a Digital Deluxe bundle adds the soundtrack and art book. Store description: welcome to your new vampiric life in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks. You play a young vampire trying to show your skeptical father, Count Dracula, that a compassionate life is possible. Raise mystical crops, learn spell-casting and potion-making, decorate your home and build relationships with a town of werewolves, witches and mermaids.

variants.label: Backyard Baseball (2026)
variants.seed_text: Backyard Baseball (2026). Kids' arcade baseball sports game, a reimagining of the classic Backyard Baseball series. Developer: Mega Cat Studios; publisher/rights holder: Playground Productions. Announced February 2026 at IGN Fan Fest. Platforms: PC (Steam) and Mac at launch, with console versions (PlayStation, Xbox, Switch) announced; some console dates later than PC. Release: July 9, 2026. Franchise status: revival of a long-running franchise, described as the first original entry to reach consoles in 15 years. Not early access. Price: 39.99 USD. No microtransactions. Content: 11 remastered stadiums, 24 original teams, 6 game modes and a roster of 30 Backyard characters, with modern 3D visuals plus 2D elements evoking the original games.

variants.label: Denshattack!
variants.seed_text: Denshattack! Arcade-style trick/platforming action game in which you pull stunts with trains. Developer: Undercoders. Publisher: Fireshine Games. Platforms: PC (Steam, Windows), PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2. Release: July 15, 2026 (delayed from June 17 for extra polish). Franchise status: new IP. Not early access; a free Steam demo was available before launch. Price: 19.99 EUR on Steam (standard), with a Digital Deluxe Edition adding seasonal train skins. Single-player only. Store description: a fast, arcade-style train-tricks game set in a colourful dystopian Japan, where you take on rival gangs and a megacorporation by grinding, jumping and flipping your train across the city.

variants.label: Halo: Campaign Evolved
variants.seed_text: Halo: Campaign Evolved. First-person shooter; a remake of the original Halo: Combat Evolved campaign. Developer: Halo Studios (Xbox). Platforms: Xbox Series X|S, PC (Steam), PlayStation 5. Release: July 28, 2026. Franchise status: remake within the Halo franchise. Not early access. Price: Standard Edition 49.99 USD, Premium Edition 69.99 USD. Solo play or online co-op for up to four players with crossplay and cross-progression.

Publisher: Skystone Games (founded by Diablo co-creators David Brevik and Bill Wang). Platforms: PC (Steam, Microsoft Store), PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S; day one on Xbox Game Pass. Price: Standard Edition 24.99 USD, Deluxe Edition 39.99 USD, 10% launch discount. Description: hunt solo or in three-player squads in the Gyldenmist, a fog-covered dark fantasy world; PvPvE extraction gameplay. Six classes: Mercenary, Sorcerer, Black Arrow, Shadow Strix, Seer and Withered Knight.

title: Games released the week of 2026-08-03 (Aug 4-6)

variants.label: Big Walk
variants.seed_text: Big Walk. Online cooperative adventure about walking, talking and teamwork. Developer: House House. Publisher: Panic. Platforms: PC and Mac (Steam), PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2. Release: August 4, 2026. Franchise status: new IP. Not early access. Price: 19.99 USD with a 25% launch discount. Multiplayer: 2 to 12 online players, cross-platform; no single-player mode and no public matchmaking. Description: a hand-crafted cooperative adventure meant to be played start to finish with a group of friends. Set out together through a wide-open world full of challenges, puzzles and discoveries; communication is central, and when players suddenly find themselves speechless they have to find other ways to communicate.

variants.label: Beast of Reincarnation
variants.seed_text: Beast of Reincarnation. Single-player action RPG with a melee combat focus. Developer: GAME FREAK (the Pokemon studio's first big non-Pokemon action game). Publisher: Fictions. Platforms: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC (Steam); Xbox Play Anywhere and day one on Xbox Game Pass Ultimate. Release: August 4, 2026. Franchise status: new IP. Not early access. Price: Standard Edition 59.99 USD, Digital Deluxe 69.99 USD (cosmetics and currency). Description: in a post-apocalyptic Japan, Emma and her dog companion Koo hunt powerful beasts on a journey to eventually face the Beast of Reincarnation. Combat centers on melee action and coordinated battles with your companion rather than capturing or raising creatures.

variants.label: MARVEL Tokon: Fighting Souls
variants.seed_text: MARVEL Tokon: Fighting Souls. 2D tag-team fighting game. Developer: Arc System Works (Guilty Gear, Dragon Ball FighterZ). Publisher: PlayStation Publishing. Platforms: PlayStation 5 and PC (Steam). Release: August 6, 2026. Franchise status: new game using Marvel characters. Not early access. Price: Standard 59.99 USD, Digital Deluxe 84.99 USD, Ultimate 99.99 USD (the latter two include a Year 1 pass). Description: a 4-vs-4 tag-team fighter with a shared health bar, launching with 20 Marvel heroes and villains including the X-Men, and a story mode written by comics writer Kieron Gillen.
